patterns-tabs--default.name: Default

patterns-tabs--overflow.name: Overflow
patterns-tabs--overflow.description:
Tabs too wide for their container: the tab list scrolls sideways, and shows a scroll button at each end that has more
tabs. A click on one scrolls the next tab into view. Set `selected` to a tab past the edge, such as 4 for Features, and
the list scrolls it fully into view, as it does for a click on a tab or a key. Turn off `moreTabs` to remove two tabs,
so the rest fit and the buttons hide.

patterns-tabs--hover.name: Hover
patterns-tabs--hover.description: The pointer over Stats: the tab fills its box, and its label turns to the default color.

patterns-tabs--focus.name: Focus
patterns-tabs--focus.description: Keyboard focus on the selected tab: the focus ring outside the tab, which keeps its selected look.
